Death of Rabindranath Tagore_
1942 Arrival of Cripps Mission in India, Quit India movement launched
(August 8).
1943-44 S.C. Bose forms Provisional Government of Free India and Indian
National Army in Singapore; Bengal famine:
1945 Trial of Indian National Army at Red Fort; Shimla Conference;
World War II ends_
1946 British Cabinet Mission visits India; Interim government formed
at the Centre.
1947 Division of India; India & Pakistan form separate independent
dominions.

nearly 70 structural stone temples important in the development of Hindu
architecture and sculpture_
Ajanta Caves 66 miles north of Aurangabad in Maharashtra State
These are rock-cut Buddhist caves, 29 in number: These caves represent
record of unique painting; sculpture and architecture of the period from
about the Znd century B.C. to about 7th century AD.
